_about: Where the Latest bot looks for news (see bot/latest.md). Edit freely: add a feed or a search, remove one that only brings noise.

feeds.name: The Black Vault (document archive)
feeds.note: FOIA releases; trace each to the primary document

feeds.name: The Debrief
feeds.note: science and defense; many non-UAP stories, filter hard

feeds.name: Liberation Times
feeds.note: UAP policy and Congress; often anonymous sources, follow the named ones

watchlist_feeds: node scripts/watchlist.mjs --queries  → one Google News feed per key person, program and organization on file (top 60 by connections)
searches: AARO announcement OR report OR case resolution (last 3 days)
UAP Disclosure Act OR UAPDA NDAA amendment Senate (last 3 days)
House Oversight UAP task force Luna OR Burlison OR Burchett (last 3 days)
UAP hearing OR briefing Congress (upcoming or last 3 days)
ODNI OR DNI Gabbard UAP (last 3 days)
site:youtube.com UAP interview (last 3 days) — names from the watchlist: Grusch, Stratton, Elizondo, Mellon, Gallaudet, Graves, Fravor, Nolan, Loeb
UAP sighting military OR pilot OR FAA report (last 3 days)
blocked_for_scripts: aaro.mil, war.gov, dni.gov, congress.gov pages and reddit.com refuse plain downloads: reach them through web search results and the search tool's page fetch, or cite the outlet that quotes them and say so
not_sources: Reddit, Discord, anonymous X accounts and content farms: may point to a story, never cite them
Wikipedia: never a source for a news item
